notes: Item Tracker alpha preview, second build. Unsigned, opt-in, and may change incompatibly between previews. Works with OCRX engine v2.1.1 or later; the engine no longer shows plugin pages, so Item Tracker opens its own window. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 include. Built on Ocrx.Sdk 2.9.0.
changes: Changed: Item Tracker shows your items in its own window instead of a page in the OCRX window.
Added: An Item Tracker icon in the notification area opens the window. Closing the window hides it, and the tracker keeps running.
Added: An "Open window at startup" setting, on by default, decides whether the window opens when OCRX starts the plugin.
